Chameleon.design: Single shared image tokenizer (VQ, 8192 codebook) for both understanding and generation; pure autoregressive next-token prediction over interleaved image+text token streams (early fusion).
Chameleon.limitation_for_our_task: Uses ONE visual representation for both tasks, so understanding suffers (semantics vs pixel-level reconstruction trade-off).

LLaVA.design: Pre-trained CLIP ViT-L/14 vision encoder + linear projector to LLM input space; LLM stays autoregressive and answers visual instructions.

SigLIP.design: Sigmoid contrastive loss replaces softmax in CLIP; ViT-B/16 for images, transformer for text; gives high-quality semantic visual encoder.

LlamaGen.design: VQ encoder–quantizer–decoder + Llama-style autoregressive transformer predicting image tokens (next-token prediction); 16x downsample tokenizer with 0.94 rFID.
LlamaGen.use_in_our_pipeline: Inspires the generation-side VQ tokenizer + AR generation head.

synthesis: Combine SigLIP/LLaVA-style understanding encoder + LlamaGen-style VQ tokenizer in ONE Janus-style decoupled framework, with a single Transformer trunk shared across both modalities (Chameleon-style early fusion at the SEQUENCE level, but with TWO separate visual front-ends — this is the decoupling hypothesis).
